_note: Per-repo shape declaration (PLAN-028 B0). OPTIONAL — an ABSENT file means exactly what this template ships: the single-branch model resolved against the repo's API-reported default branch, which is the behaviour that shipped before the file existed. `--tier` cannot express this: three repos share the `product` tier, so the branch set is not derivable from it. Adoption of the promotion model is per-repo opt-in; flipping `model` alone is NOT sufficient — read docs/BRANCHING.md §8 first, because the flip also moves the trust anchor of composition.yml and ai-review.yml.

branching._note: To adopt the promotion model: set model to `dev-staging-main`, create `dev` and make it the repo's GitHub default_branch, then re-run `apply-standards.sh --apply --tier <tier>` and `install.sh --update` (a --repin CANNOT deliver the trigger-arm change — it rewrites `uses:` tag strings only).
